status: Closed — source repair and frozen regression re-verified
finding: A successful taskflow close can leave an append-only git-head receipt dirty. The normal record-commit command requires an already staged record-only set, but exposes no path-bounded staging route. Creating an ATM-only cleanup task is correctly rejected because done requires a real non-.atm deliverable.
expectedBehavior: ATM should provide one governed, path-bounded route that persists a generated git-head receipt without absorbing foreign dirty work and without requiring a synthetic product deliverable or native Git emergency commit.
evidenceOrRepro: TASK-TMP-0022 closed successfully at framework commit 8be92971134f53b32dcaa0f7723241f12d86ef26 and left only .atm/history/evidence/git-head.jsonl outside the active TASK-MBX-0001 WIP. TASK-TMP-0023 demonstrated that taskflow close fails closed for an ATM-only card, while git record-commit returns ATM_GIT_RECORD_COMMIT_EMPTY_INDEX because there is no governed path-bounded staging operation.
containment: The emergency keep-list is restricted to the generated git-head receipt and this backlog shard. TASK-MBX-0001 and mailbox-protocol files remain excluded and untouched.
followUp: The governed route now exists and is published: source repair d401cc4dd163e2e1d18ef396c6b87c0e5ddb3e97 is an ancestor of the current sealed runner, whose sourceSeal.valid=true and syncRequired=false. The focused regression node --strip-types tests/cli/git-record-commit.test.ts passed again; it proves git record-commit --paths stages only the declared low-risk history record, excludes unrelated source work, and leaves no staged residue. Formal closeout remains separate.
